scientific_integrity: Exhaustive finite-dimensional algebraic classification, with independent exact characteristic-two Groebner implementations and finite-group action checks. The review is not an external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for bidegree-(3,4) curves on a fixed split quadric under the bidegree-preserving group; four orbit representatives have distinct point-count profiles; publication priority versus unindexed classifications remains uncertain.
title: Four arithmetic types of minimum-degree smooth filling curves on the binary split quadric
